summary: Implements 7 Kubernetes-client-dependent packages (config extension, secrets, database, deployment, job, tls, policy extension) within internal/common/ with 2 new simulators and comprehensive envtest integration tests. All planned functions are present and working: idempotent CRUD via unstructured client for CRDs, server-side apply for core resources, pure-function readiness checks, and content-hashed immutable ConfigMaps. Unit tests pass. No new go.mod dependencies. Documentation is thorough and accurate.

tests_checklist.item: Unit tests exist and pass (IsDeploymentReady, IsJobComplete)
Integration tests exist for all 7 packages with //go:build integration tag
Integration tests use TestMain with SetupEnvTest
Integration tests use t.Cleanup for teardown
All Ensure/Create functions have idempotency tests
Owner reference tests verify refs are set correctly
Pure functions have table-driven unit tests
Edge cases covered (not found, missing key, invalid YAML)
New simulators have ready + idempotent tests
Assertions are specific (exact values, not just no-error)
EnsureCertificate test verifies full issuerRef (name, kind, group)
EnsureDatabaseUser idempotency test verifies both User and Grant survive

code_quality_checklist.item: All new packages have doc.go with (CC-0005) convention
Unstructured client used for CRD interactions (MariaDB, ESO, cert-manager)
Typed client used for core resources (ConfigMap, Secret, Deployment, Service, Job, CronJob)
Error wrapping consistent with fmt.Errorf(': %w', err) pattern
Function signatures consistent (ctx, client, params, ownerRefs variadic)
golangci-lint passes with no new warnings
go vet passes on all new packages
Parameter ordering consistent across package APIs

security_checklist.item: No sensitive data exposed in logs
Error messages do not leak internal details beyond K8s resource identifiers
Nil pointer guards on pure functions
Type assertions from unstructured safely guarded with ok checks

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is as simple as possible
Follows existing patterns from simulators/helpers.go and CC-0004
Server-side apply uses field manager parameter (not hardcoded)
Owner references correctly propagated from variadic args
Idempotency via AlreadyExists for create-style, SSA for apply-style

fail_fast_checklist.item: NotFound handled gracefully where specified (false, nil)

defensive_checklist.item: Nil deployment/job handled in pure functions
Empty ownerRefs variadic handled (no empty slice set)
Missing YAML key in ConfigMap returns descriptive error

architecture_findings.description: RunDBSyncJob accepts image as plain string instead of types.ImageSpec as specified in the plan. Simpler but deviates from documented API in Key Components and Task 3.3.
architecture_findings.fix: Change parameter to image types.ImageSpec and use fmt.Sprintf('%s:%s', image.Repository, image.Tag) for the container image, or update the plan documentation to reflect the simplified API.

issues_found.description: golangci-lint SA1019: client.Apply is deprecated. Use client.Client.Apply() instead of c.Patch(ctx, deploy, client.Apply, ...). Same issue at line 62 for EnsureService.
issues_found.fix: Replace c.Patch(ctx, deploy, client.Apply, client.FieldOwner(fieldManager), client.ForceOwnership) with the new client.Client.Apply() API. See controller-runtime migration guide.

issues_found.description: golangci-lint SA1019: client.Apply is deprecated in EnsureCronJob. Same deprecated pattern as deployment package.
issues_found.fix: Replace c.Patch(ctx, cronJob, client.Apply, ...) with client.Client.Apply().

issues_found.description: Parameter ordering inconsistency: IsExternalSecretReady(ctx, c, name, namespace) but IsSecretReady(ctx, c, namespace, name) and GetSecretValue(ctx, c, namespace, name, key). All other new CC-0005 packages use (name, namespace) ordering. This creates a latent bug risk — callers mixing these functions can silently swap name/namespace since both are strings.
issues_found.fix: Standardize IsSecretReady and GetSecretValue to (name, namespace) order to match IsExternalSecretReady and all other CC-0005 packages (database, deployment, job, tls, config). Update integration tests accordingly.

issues_found.description: EnsureDatabaseUser is 86 lines (guideline: <= 40). It handles two logically distinct operations (User CR + Grant CR) in a single function body with parallel structure.
issues_found.fix: Extract the Grant CR creation into a helper function ensureGrant(ctx, c, name, namespace, mariadbRefName, database, username string, privileges []string, ownerRefs ...metav1.OwnerReference) error, reducing EnsureDatabaseUser to ~45 lines.

issues_found.description: SimulateCertificateReady and SimulatePushSecretReady (pushsecret.go:20-54) are near-identical (~54 lines each), differing only in GVK and error message strings. Both manually implement what a conditions-only variant of simulateUnstructuredReady could provide.
issues_found.fix: Add a simulateConditionsOnlyReady(ctx, c, gvk, name, namespace, condReason, condMessage) helper to helpers.go (parallel to simulateUnstructuredReady but without the status.ready boolean), then reduce both simulators to one-liner calls matching the mariadb.go/memcached.go pattern.

issues_found.description: TestMain creates a fixed namespace 'test-simulators' with hardcoded Name (not GenerateName). All 12 test functions share this namespace. Unlike all other CC-0005 test files which use GenerateName + t.Cleanup per test, this creates shared mutable state. Running tests in parallel or re-running without a fresh envtest could cause AlreadyExists failures.
issues_found.fix: Add a createTestNamespace helper using GenerateName: 'test-simulators-' and pass the generated namespace into each test. Register t.Cleanup to delete the namespace. Matches the pattern in database_integration_test.go, secrets_integration_test.go, etc.

issues_found.description: TestEnsureCertificate_Creates checks issuerRef.name but not issuerRef.kind ('ClusterIssuer') or issuerRef.group ('cert-manager.io'). A regression that swaps kind or group would not be detected.
issues_found.fix: Add assertions for issuerRef.kind and issuerRef.group after line 78.

issues_found.description: TestEnsureDatabaseUser_Idempotent only checks no-error on the second call. Does not verify that both User and Grant CRs still exist with correct spec after the second call. A regression that deletes the Grant on re-invocation would pass silently.
issues_found.fix: After the second call, fetch both User CR (name='idem-user') and Grant CR (name='idem-user-grant') and assert they still exist.

issues_found.description: Magic string '*' for Grant wildcard table. This MariaDB-operator semantic value appears once with no constant or comment explaining it means 'all tables'.
issues_found.fix: Extract to a named constant: const grantAllTables = "*"

issues_found.description: TestCreateImmutableConfigMap_DeterministicHash is semantically equivalent to TestCreateImmutableConfigMap_Idempotent — both call the function twice with identical data and assert the same name is returned. Neither tests the hash computation independently.
issues_found.fix: Consider testing hashData determinism via a unit test on the unexported function, or remove the duplicate test.

suggested_improvements: Extract createTestNamespace into testutil package as a shared helper to eliminate duplication across 5 integration test files
Add a package-level const DefaultFieldManager = 'cobaltcore-operator' (or similar) in deployment/ and job/ packages with a doc comment explaining the recommended SSA field manager value
Consider whether RunDBSyncJob should use types.ImageSpec as the plan specifies, or update the plan documentation to match the simpler string parameter
next_steps: Fix deprecated client.Apply usage in deployment/deployment.go and job/job.go — migrate to client.Client.Apply() API
Standardize parameter ordering in secrets/ package: change IsSecretReady and GetSecretValue to (name, namespace) order
Extract simulateConditionsOnlyReady helper in testutil/simulators/helpers.go to deduplicate certificate.go and pushsecret.go
Refactor EnsureDatabaseUser to extract Grant CR creation into a helper function
Fix simulators_integration_test.go to use GenerateName namespaces per test
Add missing issuerRef.kind and issuerRef.group assertions to TestEnsureCertificate_Creates
Add User+Grant existence assertions to TestEnsureDatabaseUser_Idempotent
Re-run golangci-lint to confirm zero warnings after fixes
